Dragon Fight (Made with Seedance 2.0)

It’s insane how far AI filmmaking has come! I think we’re witnessing a new revolution in how VFX will be done in the future. This entire clip took under 30 minutes to make using only 5 reference images. Made with Seedance 2.0. https://t.co/LrGAZzBKEi
content: Use 5 reference images in Seedance 2.0 to generate an entire clip quickly (e.g., under 30 minutes).
